title: Source
description: A research source with stable identity. source_id = sha256(canonical_locator)[:16].

source_id.description: sha256(canonical_locator)[:16] — stable across edits and continuation

canonical_locator.description: Canonical identifier: doi:10.1038/..., arxiv:2305.14251, or normalized URL (scheme+host+path, no fragment/tracking params)

raw_url.description: Original URL as retrieved, before normalization

venue.description: Journal, conference, preprint server, or publisher venue when available

provider_ids.description: Provider-specific IDs, e.g. semantic_scholar paperId, PMID, PMCID, DOI

citation_count.description: Citation count from Semantic Scholar or another provider when recorded

influential_citation_count.description: Influential citation count from Semantic Scholar when recorded

open_access_pdf_url.description: Open-access PDF URL from Semantic Scholar or another provider when available

document_date.description: Publication, filing, presentation, label, or source document date when available

retrieved_at.description: Timestamp when the source was retrieved

metadata_status.description: How far metadata has been verified

editorial_notice_status.description: Machine-checkable Scite/editorial-notice status for peer-reviewed sources

scite_checked_at.description: Timestamp when Scite/editorial notices were checked

registered_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when source was registered
